original_test_intent: Prove the intended BMC UART is routed to the designated USB-C connector and supports clean bidirectional traffic through the authorized cable, adapter and peer without corrupting the BMC console, login prompt, debug channel or management availability.
original_method: Map the BMC UART controller/device-tree alias and physical connector to a stable tty plus USB-C adapter/peer; determine whether the line is a console, debug or application channel; preserve current getty/console ownership and BMC logs; have an operator connect the approved loopback/peer; configure both ends with the authorized serial profile; exchange a bounded framed payload both directions; compare bytes/order/timeouts and UART counters; close the fd and restore the original service/ownership state without killing getty, altering bootargs, resetting BMC USB/UART or retrying automatically.
manual_activity: An operator identifies and photographs the BMC-UART-to-USB-C physical path, connects the approved isolated loopback/peer, and confirms an independent management path remains available during the traffic check.
required_inputs: BMC UART controller/device-tree alias to connector, adapter and stable tty mapping
Current console/getty/debug/service ownership and independent management recovery path
Baud, data bits, parity, stop bits, flow control, payload/directions, timeout and allowable UART error deltas
Approved peer/loopback, access method, cleanup and BMC recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Select the BMC tty by device-tree/topology and stable adapter identity, not wildcard order
Confirm the UART is not the active sole management console or secure debug line; retain independent OOB recovery
Do not stop getty, change kernel bootargs/device-tree, disclose credentials, send shell escape/control sequences or transmit unbounded data
Preserve complete UART/USB/kernel/BMC logs and management health; do not clear evidence or reset the BMC/UART/USB stack to retry
Stop on prompt/debug interaction, management degradation, wrong peer, framing/parity/overrun errors or disconnect; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate BMC UART topology, stable tty, service/console ownership, serial profile, peer and recovery path
Collect complete driver/topology/ownership baseline and, after operator setup, perform the approved bounded two-way exchange
Verify exact payload integrity, UART error deltas and uninterrupted BMC management, then close and restore the original state
Do not use insecure `sshpass`, select a wildcard tty, interfere with getty/console, reset BMC devices or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve BMC UART/device-tree/USB-C/tty mapping and console/getty/debug ownership
Approve isolated loopback/peer, serial profile, bounded payload, error/timeout limits and independent recovery
Review path-bound traffic plus BMC management-health evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Device listing and logs are discovery only; the quoted SSH command is malformed, exposes a password with `sshpass`, truncates dmesg and cannot prove the USB-C mapping or bidirectional traffic.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use authenticated BMC access to record device-tree/tty ownership and full serial/USB logs, then open only the approved non-critical tty and exchange the bounded framed payload with the operator-confirmed peer while monitoring BMC management health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC-to-USB-C bidirectional UART scope and 20/20-minute allocation remain; tty, service ownership, serial settings and peer are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM APPROVAL-GATED BMC-UART-TO-USB-C BIDIRECTIONAL AND MANAGEMENT-SAFETY CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind BMC controller and device-tree alias to the connector/tty, prove the port is safe to open, then perform two-way framed traffic with exact byte/error accounting and continuous management monitoring.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds BMC console/getty ownership, independent recovery, stable topology, actual traffic proof and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A BMC may expose several ttyS/ttyUSB nodes, including its active console; listing them neither identifies the external USB-C path nor proves RX/TX function.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Writing a BMC console/debug tty can execute commands, expose credentials, disturb boot or sever the only management path.

project_override_considerations: A BMC firmware self-loop test is acceptable only if documented to exercise the same pins and USB-C route while proving RX and TX. Inventory or tty-open success alone is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and BMC controller/device-tree/connector/adapter/tty topology
Operator connection photo and independent management/recovery proof
Full device ownership/getty/console baseline, USB descriptors and UART/driver logs
Exact serial profile and timestamped two-way framed payload with byte/order/content, timeout and UART-error comparisons
Continuous BMC management health and restored closed/original service state

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2167 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00054-V002: approve BMC UART controller/device-tree alias to USB-C/adapter/stable tty mapping; console/getty/debug ownership and independent recovery path; peer/loopback, serial settings, bounded payload/directions, timeout/error limits, cleanup, and recovery.

review_improvement: Requires real two-way BMC UART traffic while explicitly protecting the management console and restoring service ownership, avoiding a false pass from mere tty enumeration.
independent_technical_reasoning: BMC images commonly expose multiple serial nodes for SoC UARTs, host console, debug and USB gadget/adapter functions. The source names the physical BMC-to-USB-C route, so the tty must be mapped through device-tree/topology and its current console/getty role understood before any write. End-to-end framed traffic is required by the send/receive criterion, but preserving independent management is the case-specific safety condition because a wrong BMC UART write can affect the control plane itself.
